meta_title: Fight a Speeding Ticket in Calgary | Fabsy
meta_description: Review a Calgary speeding ticket, its printed deadline, available disclosure, and whether Fabsy's agent service can assist.
h1: Fight a Speeding Ticket in Calgary
hook: If you want to dispute a speeding ticket in Calgary, follow its printed instructions and request the available disclosure; Fabsy offers a free eligibility review.
bullets: Disclosure review helps identify the available response options
what: Fighting a speeding ticket means formally disputing the charge: request disclosure, review evidence, then decide how to proceed.
how: Request disclosure, gather photos/witnesses, and consider Fabsy's free eligibility review to determine next steps.
next: Upload a photo of your ticket for a free check.

faqs.a: Pricing is a flat $488 plus 30% of any fine reduction achieved; there is no additional charge if the fine is not reduced.
Attendance requirements depend on the charge, the court, and what happens in the matter. We will tell you if personal attendance is required.
faqs.q: Do I need to appear in court?

faqs.a: Timing depends on the court, disclosure, and the path the matter takes. We will keep you updated as it progresses.
